decisions.reason: As a core two-component resin injection unit that fits the firm's established application-equipment business and remained prominently presented through 2019, it is likely worth retaining unless sales proved clearly disappointing.

This second resin injection unit also matches the company's specialist portfolio and, for a medium-sized German machinery maker, such niche variants are typically kept when they serve distinct customer specifications.
An automatic airless spray gun is close to the firm's core spray technology offering, so it is likely to remain on the market as part of a broader system solution for industrial users.
A manual airless spray gun is a standard complementary product in this firm's range and is likely to be kept because it supports installed equipment sales, spare parts, and service business.
Because this air-assisted airless spray gun is a product line with several models and directly supports the firm's main coating applications, it has the strongest case to stay in the portfolio.

The data logger is strategically interesting but less central to the firm's traditional hardware strengths, and its reduced visibility from a dedicated page in 2018 to only a mention in 2019 suggests a weaker standalone position.
